task: Using the supplied molecular identities and experimental TE surface areas, independently test whether conformer sampling materially changes the theoretical electron-density surface of 1,4-dioxane and 1-pentanethiol. Generate, screen, deduplicate, refine, and weight conformers with a resource-aware workflow of your own design. Compare the lowest-energy conformer with the final ensemble using newly generated quantum and isosurface artifacts.
scientific_mode_description: The scientific question and input data are fixed, but no software, method, conformer route, cutoff grid, provider, or stopping path is prescribed.
scientific_requirements: Perform an actual conformer search from the supplied molecular identities rather than assuming one input geometry is representative.
Record the candidate count, energy window, deduplication rule, exclusions, and normalized statistical weights.
Compare single-conformer and ensemble predictions against the supplied experimental TE surfaces.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, resource tiers, validation gates, stopping criteria, and revisions.
One provenance record per real chemistry-software invocation.
Failed or inconclusive branches and their scientific consequence.
Artifact-linked scientific report separating computed results, experiment, inference, and uncertainty.
All generated or supplied conformers, validation, deduplication, and status.
Energy convention and normalized statistical weights.
Conformer and cutoff resolved surface areas.
Single-conformer versus ensemble results and experimental errors.

data.name: Electron Isodensity open-discovery inputs
data.description: Task-specific molecular identities and experimental TE inputs only. No paper method, route, conformer, calculation output, or result is included.
